body.focus: ISSUE-6d73bf1602816c8f (small bugfix): a session id that is not a single path segment (empty, '.', '..', or containing '/', '\\' or NUL) is refused by session.delete with its existing invalid-input answer before anything is purged, and purgeSession (src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts), on every path that reaches it (session.delete, session.deleteBulk, agent.discard, expiry/cap purge), removes a tmp directory only when it is a direct child of PATHS.tmp, logging and skipping otherwise. Single-segment ids keep today's behaviour.
body.summary: Re-applied the session-id path guard taken out of s2 (41ba9df6f): session.delete refuses an id that is not a single path segment with invalid-input before anything is purged, and the shared purge removes a tmp directory only when the new sessionTmpDir finds it a direct child of the tmp root (logs and skips otherwise), covering deleteBulk, agent.discard and expiry. Tests cover the refusal (with every dependency untouchable) and sessionTmpDir; the session-source inventory digest for handler-runtime.ts is refreshed.
